title: REDMOD: pancreatic cancer signals in CT scans taken before diagnosis
summary: Among nearly 2,000 abdominal CT scans originally considered normal, an AI radiomics model identified 73% of prediagnostic pancreatic cancers, with a median lead time of about 16 months. Validation included images from multiple institutions and protocols. This analysis used scans taken before diagnosis; clinical benefit and false positives in practice still need prospective evaluation.
